title: In basic training when President Kennedy is assassinated
description: Larry remembers being about a month into basic training, at Fort Ord on Monterey Bay, California, when President Kennedy was shot on November 22, 1963. That fits his DD-214, which records his induction on October 28, 1963 — almost exactly a month earlier — and not the family's old belief that he was drafted in 1964.
researchNotes: His account: the 2026-08-12 phone call (2026-call-kennedy-basic-training, paraphrase; research/interviews/2026-08-12-call-notes.md). Fort Ord is his: "Basic training was in Port Ord in Monterey Bay California. September ‘63. Was there from September until probably January" (giscus-vn-0024-c18119890, 2026-08-22, transcribed) — which retired the note that had called the location unknown. Tension kept, not reconciled: he places the start of basic in September 1963; the form puts induction at 28 October 1963 (1963-10-28-inducted, confirmed). A late-October induction fits "about a month into basic" on 22 November, so the September may be memory rounding backward. The rating (strongly-supported) is for his being in basic training that day, which the DD-214 date supports; the Kennedy day itself is a story for him to tell, not a question to check.
